LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.sum_mul_entropy_l: For finite mixing probabilities rᵢ and component laws pᵢ on a finite alphabet, H(∑ᵢ rᵢpᵢ) ≥ ∑ᵢ rᵢH(pᵢ).
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.binaryMixture_ent: For 0 ≤ t ≤ 1 and finite laws p and q, H(tp + (1−t)q) ≥ tH(p) + (1−t)H(q).
For 0 < t < 1 and finite laws p and q, equality H(tp + (1−t)q) = tH(p) + (1−t)H(q) holds if and only if p = q.
